messages.subject: Major shinyFiles update
parts:
I'm happy to announce that a major update to shinyFiles has just been send to CRAN and will likely become available within the next couple of days.

The update expands the server file system access by adding folder selection (much like choose.dir() on windows systems) and file saving dialog boxes.

With both folder selection and file saving it is possible to create new folders on the fly - shinyFiles monitors the permissions of the current location to make sure that write permissions are available.

With the file saver it is possible to specify different choices of filetypes - each filetype can contain multiple extensions (eg. jpg and jpeg).
